title: Description tail of a circuit encoding
statement: Let $C$ be a finite acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, whose gates are listed in topological order with every gate reading only input or earlier vertices, and whose output is a vertex of the circuit. The description-tail transducer applied to the encoding of $C$ returns the unary encoding of the output vertex: a string of $C$'s output-index many $1$s followed by $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $n$ is a natural number giving the number of input vertices
The circuit has a finite list of gates in topological order
Each gate reads only input vertices or earlier gates
The output index is less than the total number of input and gate vertices
